name: task-search

scripts.build: npm run changelog -- check && tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=cjs --target=es2020 --platform=browser --external:obsidian --external:electron --loader:.md=text --outfile=main.js
scripts.test: esbuild src/logic.ts --format=cjs --outfile=.test/logic.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/block-config.ts --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=.test/block-config.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/block-source.ts --format=cjs --outfile=.test/block-source.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/changelog.ts --format=cjs --outfile=.test/changelog.cjs --log-level=warning && node --test test/logic.test.cjs test/block-config.test.cjs test/block-source.test.cjs test/changelog.test.cjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

description: Lists tasks from notes whose properties match a query, grouped by frontmatter title, with live filters by text, tag and task status.
